name: Full-stack example: Orchestration + Persistency + Lifecycle health
description: Complex showcase combining SCORE modules: a Kyron async runtime executes a timer-triggered orchestration design that accumulates sensor readings across 5 cycles and persists the final count to a KVS JSON snapshot from the program's stop action, while a lifecycle health monitor records alive deadline checkpoints on a dedicated supervision thread (connecting to the launch-manager supervisor when launched supervised)
